term: uniformity in a supplied outcome basis
definition: Uniform trace holds when every pair of indexed values of the complete trace agrees. It compares outcome coordinates in one supplied basis; testing Uniform on recodedTrace applies the corresponding syntactic coordinate test to a changed basis, and is a different criterion.
note: For a nonempty pre-cutoff prefix the original and recoded tests select opposite candidates. Endorsing either as physically natural, projectible or practically preferable is an explicit open additional commitment; this criterion is not contained in finite observed agreement.
